{{Short description|Dutch chemist (1925–2025)}}
[[file:Jan Drenth.jpg|thumb|Jan Drenth between 1992 and 2005]]
'''Jan Drenth''' (20 February 1925 – 11 February 2025) was a Dutch chemist. He was a professor of structural chemistry at the [[University of Groningen]] from 1969 to 1990.<ref name=rug>{{cite web|author= |url=http://hoogleraren.ub.rug.nl/?page=showPerson&type=hoogleraar&hoogleraar_id=632&lang=nl |title=Jan Drenth, 1925 |language=Dutch |publisher=University of Groningen |date= |accessdate=17 September 2016}}</ref>

==Life and career==
Drenth was born in [[Groningen]] on 20 February 1925.<ref name=rug/> He obtained his PhD in mathematics and physics under Eelco Wiebenga at the University of Groningen in 1957, with a dissertation titled: ''Een röntgenografisch onderzoek van excelsine, edestine en tabakszaadglobuline''. Drenth subsequently moved to New York, United States, where he became a post-doc and studied [[X-ray crystallography#Biological macromolecular crystallography|protein crystallography]] under Barbara Low. Drenth then returned to the Netherlands and in 1967 was appointed [[Lecturer|lector]].<ref name=rug/><ref>{{cite book|title=Een verborgen revolutie: de computerisering van de Rijksuniversiteit Groningen|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=3VERAgAAQBAJ&pg=PA59|year=2012|publisher=Uitgeverij Verloren|isbn=978-90-8704-298-1|pages=59–}}</ref> In 1969 he was appointed professor of structural chemistry, which he remained until his retirement in 1990.<ref name=rug/>

Drenth was elected a member of the [[Royal Netherlands Academy of Arts and Sciences]] in 1973.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.knaw.nl/en/members/members/4049 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160917214121/https://www.knaw.nl/en/members/members/4049 |title=Jan Drenth |publisher=Royal Netherlands Academy of Arts and Sciences |archive-date=17 September 2016 |url-status=dead }}</ref>

Drenth died on 11 February 2025, at the age of 99.<ref>{{cite web |title=De vader van de Groningse structuurbiologie |url=https://www.rug.nl/research/gbb/news/de-vader-van-de-groningse-structuurbiologie |website=University of Groningen |date=13 February 2025 |access-date=19 February 2025}}</ref>
